item.title: LinkedIn Headshot From Park Photo

turns.text: Can you turn this into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please.

item.tests: Creates a polished LinkedIn headshot from the supplied photo while preserving the subject's identity.

answer_sheet.Clothing and background: Navy blazer and plain light grey background.
answer_sheet.Lighting and expression: Natural, approachable and professional; keep my smile.

must_haves: The woman is recognisably the same person as in portrait-woman.jpg, with her curly dark hair retained.
The park is replaced with a plain light grey background.
The square image has a centred head-and-shoulders composition with the full top of her hair visible.
Lighting and skin texture look natural, without obvious facial or clothing artifacts.

turns.text: Can you turn this pic into a square LinkedIn headshot? A navy blazer and a plain light grey background, please. I'm on the free plan and don't want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—I can make it square with a **navy blazer and plain light-grey background**, keeping your face and hair natural.

The cheapest listed option is:
- **One 640 × 640 image** using the free-plan-compatible **Flux 2 Klein** editor.
- Change the outfit, background and headshot framing together in one edit.
- **Listed starting cost: 5 credits**, compared with **50 credits** for the dedicated headshot tool.

This is the smallest, lowest-cost listed editing option; “shorter” only applies to video. I can’t verify an exact account-specific charge with the tools available, so **5 credits is the advertised starting price, not a guaranteed quote**.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** Would you like to proceed with the single 640 × 640 edit?

turns.agent:
The edit was blocked because your account has **insufficient credits**. Nothing was generated, and **no credits were spent**.

I used the lowest-cost listed option: one square 640px image with Flux 2 Klein, starting at 5 credits. There isn’t a cheaper listed generation option available here.

For a no-credit alternative, you could use a free photo editor to replace the background with light grey and crop for LinkedIn, though adding a realistic blazer would require more manual editing.
